name: Example: Applying Row Operations to a Complex Matrix
problem:
Given the matrix ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14045065/assets/766ddf98a05c69ef0791858a7f32457425cf1a9650d2205227ffc7d9d173d2e7.png) find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operations:

$$
R_1 := \dfrac{1}{\textrm{i}}R_1, \qquad R_2 := R_2 - 2\textrm{i}R_1
$$
worked_solution:
Let's apply the row operations to $A\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}\text{i} & -\text{i} \\ 2+2\text{i} & 1\end{aligned}]\, &  & {R}_{1}:=\frac{1}{\text{i}}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 2+2\text{i} & 1\end{aligned}]\, &  & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}-2\text{i}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 2 & 1+2\text{i}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the result is
